name: Sakuranbo Strasse
original_name: さくらんぼシュトラッセ
source:
Summer is starting; cherry blossoms have turned to fruit.
After overcoming various trials and tribulations, the residents of Kamome are enjoying their newly attained happiness.

Here are four stories of love and their afterstories.

[Translated from [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/sakuranbo/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
夏日将至，樱花已经结成果实。
经历重重考验与波折后，Kamome的居民正享受着新近获得的幸福。

这里讲述的是四段恋情，以及它们此后的故事。

[翻译自[url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/sakuranbo/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
